shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/stele
row of repeated animal heads/rounded forms in a horizontal register
band of geometric pattern (zigzag/lattice) above the animal row
frame or border enclosing the composition
justification: Both surfaces show, on an upright slab, a horizontal row of repeated rounded animal heads/bodies set beneath a band of geometric net-like or zigzag patterning, which is a moderately specific shared scheme in low relief. However, A is a crowded multi-register composition with clearly identifiable profile quadrupeds, birds, a snake and a small human-like figure with arms, while B is a single sparse framed panel with an arched border, a vertical bar and only ambiguous lumpen forms, so the repertoire and density of content differ greatly.
